product.name: Aurelio PaperClip Hub 3-in-1
product.description: The Aurelio PaperClip Hub 3-in-1 is a compact desk accessory designed to keep office supplies tidy. It features a central metal clip holder for up to 200 paperclips, a side compartment for staples and a small pocket for rubber bands. The unit measures 20 cm wide, 8 cm tall and 3 cm deep, fitting comfortably on most desks. Constructed from durable polypropylene with a brushed metal finish, it offers a lightweight yet sturdy solution for both home and office environments. The bright red color adds a pop of visual interest while the ergonomic shape prevents strain during frequent use.
